name: customer-management
description: Customer Management home assignment: Angular client + Express API with file-based storage

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.start:slow: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "DELAY_MS=800 npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
